descriptionChirho: Geshur, an Aramean kingdom east of the Sea of Galilee, notably associated with Absalom's maternal grandfather Talmai king of Geshur (2 Sam 3:3, 13:37–38, 15:8). English 'Geshur/to Geshur/from Geshur', Spanish 'Guesur/en Guesur/de Guesur', Hindi गशूर/गशूर–में/गशूर–से, Arabic جَشورَ/مِن جَشورَ, Korean 그술, Swahili 'Geshuri/kutoka Geshuri'. All prepositional contexts reference the same geographic entity.
